title: A construction of the sphere-packing magic functions in dimensions 8 and 24
summary: We develop an alternative route to the solutions of the sphere-packing problem in dimensions 8 and 24, through the auxiliary functions in the Cohn--Elkies Fourier bound. In each dimension we construct a radial Schwartz function with the prescribed lattice zeros by solving a countable system of linear equations in absolutely summable coefficients. We prove existence and uniqueness after normalization, without using the known magic functions or Fourier interpolation.
